channel.title: Chain Times
channel.description: Chain Times reports crypto news: bitcoin and ether markets, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: Visa and Mesh link crypto wallets to 175 million merchants
item.description: Visa and Mesh plan to let people pay from crypto and stablecoin balances at 175 million merchant locations, using participating wallets without a separate card.

item.title: Byreal features serve different treasury jobs
item.description: Byreal’s swaps, liquidity pools and other products serve different treasury jobs, but each adds a distinct exposure teams should map to policy before use.

item.title: Why Your Across Bridge Transfer Is Still Pending
item.description: A pending Across transfer usually means the source deposit is waiting for a relayer or fallback fill; check its status and source transaction before sending again.

item.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutions
item.description: JPMorgan has deployed its dollar deposit token on Ethereum for institutional clients, giving them another public blockchain for payments and digital asset settlement.

item.title: Revolut wins Gibraltar licence for global crypto unit
item.description: Revolut has won a Gibraltar DLT licence for a new crypto subsidiary, giving it a base for international services as it plans further market expansion.

item.title: Ledger to review reseller controls after $93 million wallet theft
item.description: Ledger says it will review sales and anti-tamper controls after devices sold through CryptoBilis were linked to thefts, with reported losses topping $93 million.

item.title: Ledger finds LTE spy chip in CryptoBilis wallets
item.description: Ledger says a hidden chip in some CryptoBilis wallets copied users’ 24-word recovery phrases during setup and sent them over LTE, putting funds at risk.

item.title: Three checks before swapping for a redemption token
item.description: A redemption token can trade below the value it promises, so check its claim terms, exit route and contract, then compare the swap quote with redemption.

item.title: Judge leaves Gemini’s $5 million CFTC settlement in place
item.description: A Manhattan judge left Gemini’s $5 million CFTC penalty and permanent injunction in place, rejecting both parties’ bid to reopen a settlement reached before trial.

item.title: Why wallet policies block some bridge routes
item.description: A bridge route can fail before funds move when its wallet call breaks a rule on networks, contracts, approvals or limits; learn what to check next.

item.title: Why cross-chain swaps can deliver less than quoted
item.description: Cross-chain swap slippage is the gap between a quoted amount and what arrives; route steps, pool liquidity and timing explain why the final amount can change.

item.title: Coinbase to power stablecoin cards for Marqeta customers
item.description: Coinbase will help Marqeta customers turn stablecoin balances into card spending, with Base settling payments and Marqeta managing card issuance and processing.

item.title: What to do when a crypto bridge transfer times out
item.description: A bridge timeout does not always mean funds are lost: check the source transaction, identify the route’s status, and follow its refund or retry process.

item.title: How to Estimate a Minimum Swap Size for Each Asset Pair
item.description: Estimate a route's minimum size by comparing chain fees with the input value, then check pool depth and a fresh quote for that asset pair before sending funds.

item.title: Mantle Bridge or Swap: Which Route Fits the Transfer?
item.description: A bridge moves an asset between Ethereum and Mantle; a swap changes the asset you hold. The better route depends on your destination and total costs.

item.title: How Much Native Gas Does a Cross-Chain Swap Need?
item.description: There is no fixed gas balance for every cross-chain swap: fund the sending chain, check any destination needs, and use the quote to see what the route covers.

item.title: What a Stale Swap Quote Means and How to Refresh It
item.description: A stale swap quote can miss current pool prices; check the new output amount, slippage limit and deadline before approving or resending the trade.

item.title: Why cross-chain messages can take time to settle
item.description: Cross-chain transfers wait because the destination chain needs proof that the source action is settled, plus a verifier and transaction to accept and execute it.

item.title: How to Compare Cross-Chain Swap Quotes Before You Send
item.description: Compare cross-chain swap quotes by the amount that should arrive, all fees, route steps and time; then check the minimum output before you approve.

item.title: Match the crypto network before you send
item.description: Match the coin, network and any required memo to the exchange’s deposit instructions before sending, because a transfer on an unsupported network may not arrive.
